title: Assassin's Creed: The Rebel Collection
synopsis: Black Flag and Rogue together with their downloadable content — Ubisoft’s Nintendo Switch–exclusive collection, retained as the retail game card.

catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · retail edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
The Rebel Collection pairs two Assassin’s Creed games set in the eighteenth-century Atlantic. Assassin’s Creed IV Black Flag (Ubisoft Montreal, 2013) follows the pirate Edward Kenway; Assassin’s Creed Rogue (Ubisoft Sofia, 2014) was the first in the series told from a Templar’s side and the last made for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 generation.

Ubisoft revealed the collection in the September 4, 2019 Nintendo Direct and released it exclusively on Nintendo Switch on December 6, 2019. It includes Black Flag’s single-player downloadable content — among it Freedom Cry and Aveline — Rogue with its downloadable content, and exclusive outfits.

The filing joins the Assassin’s Creed lineage already on the shelf, beside the Steam edition of Black Flag.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Ubisoft’s retail edition of Assassin’s Creed: The Rebel Collection for Nintendo Switch.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Black Flag and its downloadable content are on the card, but Ubisoft distributes Assassin’s Creed Rogue as a free download from the Nintendo eShop — that half of the collection depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Black Flag first released in October 2013; Rogue on November 11, 2014. The Rebel Collection is a Nintendo Switch exclusive released December 6, 2019, porting the original Rogue rather than the 2018 Rogue Remastered.
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by Ubisoft, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
